A [[Chubbit]] [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] to the [[Chagrian/Legends|Chagrian]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Mors Demanna]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Noua]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Telerath/Legends|Telerath]] worked as a '''sword bearer'''. When the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]]-in-exile [[Dass Jennir]] visited Telerath, he witnessed the Chubbit at work as Demanna faced off against various opponents in sword fighting to determine who was worthy to join his [[Musori's gang|gang]].
